transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I'm here because I've been having some trouble at work. I'm a cashier, and lately, I just... I keep getting stuck doing things that don't make sense for what I'm supposed to be doing. Like, I'll start tapping the barcode scanner in this specific pattern, or I'll just freeze up completely with my hand hovering right over the open cash drawer while a customer is standing there waiting for their change. It's been happening a lot, and, well, last week my manager actually wrote me up for it. So I figured I needed to come in.
During those moments when you freeze up or tap, are you fully aware of what is happening around you?

I... I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about it like that. I mean, I know I'm stuck, and I know the customer is there waiting, but... I don't really know if I'm fully aware of everything else going on around me in the store. I just haven't noticed.
When you tap the scanner in that specific pattern, do you feel an urge or a need to do it, or does it just happen on its own?

I honestly don't know. I haven't really noticed any kind of urge or... or a need to do it beforehand. It feels more like it just happens on its own. I'll just suddenly realize that my hand is already tapping it, without me really deciding to start.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Yes, actually. Most days, I hear what sounds like a couple of people talking... just sort of off to the side of me. Sometimes they call my name, like it's coming from the stockroom. Or I'll hear them saying I rang something up wrong. But... when I turn around to look, there's nobody there. And the customers or my coworkers never seem to hear it.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or had any physical illnesses recently?
No, I haven't. I mean, I don't have any major medical problems that I know of. I haven't been to a doctor for anything physical recently, so... no, nothing like that.

No, I haven't really felt anything like that. I don't think anyone is spying on me or watching me... at least, I haven't noticed anything like that happening. It's just the voices, really.
When you freeze with your arm in the air, if someone tries to move it, does it stay in whatever position they put it?

I... no, I don't freeze like that. I've never had my arm get stuck in the air or anything, so... no one has ever had to try and move it. My body moves just fine. It's really just the voices I mentioned.
About how long have you been hearing these voices?
I'd say it's been about three months. The voices, and just... those moments where things are clearly out of place, they've been happening for about the last three months or so.
